summary: PlacementStatistics tracks and aggregates statistics for changes made to placement requests, such as alerts added, cancellations, date modifications, destination changes, supervisor assignments, and group size adjustments. Specialized business logic ensures that changes are counted based on user roles (NIS/IRP/RA), entity access, and request status, with safeguards to avoid duplicate counting and to respect access restrictions. The statistics are encapsulated in PlacementStatisticsDC, tailored for both DC and supervisor reporting.
purpose: To provide a detailed summary and audit trail of key placement request changes for reporting and operational oversight, supporting business rules for agency and user-type-specific analysis.

workflows.name: Placement Change Statistics Workflow
steps: Initialize statistics and lastPRD_ID trackers for each change type.
For each placement request, check access and agency restrictions.
For each history comment and request status, increment specific statistics counters according to business rules.
Return PlacementStatisticsDC object with accumulated stats.

business_rules: Skip entries done by the user's own agency.
For NIS/IRP, count changes only with status Sent or later.
For other RA, count changes only with status Redir or later, and only if released.
Only count supervisor changes where name is not withheld and status matches allowed codes for NIS/IRP.
Do not duplicate counts for same PRD_ID per change type.
Respect allowed locations (sites, services, destinations) for non-NIS/IRP users.
validations: Check allowed list for site, service, and destination unless user is NIS/IRP.
Verify status codes to determine which changes to count.
system_behavior: Aggregates statistics for placement request changes with role- and status-based filtering.
Supports both DC and supervisor reporting using similar logic.
exceptions: Entries from user's agency are not counted.
Parent Call for Offers placement requests are skipped.
Auto-redirected requests in Redir status are ignored in RC mode.

summary: SiteDocument represents documents stored at a site level within the HSPnet system. It includes fields for document ID and associated SiteID. No additional business rules or workflows are detailed.
purpose: To encapsulate and provide access to site-level documents within the HSPnet system.
system_behavior: Represents site-level documents with ID and SiteID fields within the HSPnet data layer.
content_gaps: No workflows, business rules, or actor information provided.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is an ASP.NET page for administrative staff, displaying last login information, site filtering, and recent submitted student employment applications. The UI features panels for error/warning messages, site and discipline dropdowns, calendar input fields, and a grid view for applications. Logic includes auto-populating dropdowns, date validations, and email link setup.
purpose: To provide administrative staff with a welcome screen showing last login, site/discipline filtering, and lists of student employment applications for management and review.

workflows.name: Welcome Staff Admin Page Load Workflow
steps: Display last login information for the user.
Fill site and discipline dropdowns according to user session and query string.
Initialize start and end date fields.
Bind the grid view with employment applications matching filter criteria.

workflows.name: Application Review Workflow
steps: Select site and discipline via dropdown filters.
Enter start and end date for application filtering.
Optionally include withdrawn applications via checkbox.
Refresh view and review submitted applications.

business_rules: Email link is only shown if user email is present.
Withdrawn applications are displayed with status and withdrawal date.
Dropdowns auto-populate with 'ALL' as the default option.
validations: Required field validation for start and end date inputs.
Regular expression validation for correct date format.
Custom validation to ensure start date is before end date.
system_behavior: Displays last login time and timezone.
Filters and presents a list of student employment applications.
Handles error and warning messages in panels.
Supports paging and sorting in grid view.
content_gaps: No security or permissions detail; actor assignment is inferred from context.

summary: ServiceCode is an entity representing a service code in the HSPnet system. It includes fields for IDs, category, name/description, sort order, and notes. The ServiceCodes class provides methods to retrieve lists of service codes by various criteria, supporting localization for alternate languages.
purpose: To encapsulate service code metadata for courses, timetables, and ASM options, supporting filtering, sorting, and localization.

workflows.name: Service Code Listing Workflow
steps: Request list of service codes for all, course, or timetable.
Fetch codes via stored procedures and parameters.
Localize codes if alt language mode is enabled.

business_rules: Use alternate language fields if user session specifies alt language mode.
system_behavior: Retrieves service code lists for courses and timetables.
content_gaps: No actor or security information present.
